name: Papahānaumokuākea
description: Papahānaumokuākea is a chain of tiny, low-lying islands and atolls stretching about 1,931 km northwest of the main Hawaiian Islands, surrounded by an immense expanse of protected Pacific Ocean. Its coral reefs, lagoons and seamounts shelter over 7,000 marine species, a quarter of them found only in Hawaiian waters. For Native Hawaiians, it is where life begins and spirits return after death.
